main_reasons: Clean KPMG audit opinion and effective ICFR; no restatement, error corrections, auditor change or material weakness disclosed

Severe financial distress: ~$26B debt, stockholders' deficiency of $2.3B, negative free cash flow, $7.4B 2027 maturities with going-concern warning if refinancing not secured by April 2026, creating pressure on reported results

Large judgmental intangibles: $1.6B franchise-rights impairment taken, but $8.0B goodwill and $11.6B franchise rights remain while fixed-rate debt trades ~$6.7B below carrying value; goodwill test passes partly because reporting unit carrying value is low/negative (CAM)

Aggressive financing maneuvers (unrestricted subsidiary designations, ABS, creditor co-op) and heavy reliance on Adjusted EBITDA, but these are disclosed and largely balance-sheet/financing matters rather than revenue manipulation
Controlled company (Drahi ~94% voting) with related-party capex and services from Altice Europe and a common-control transfer of i24 NEWS; amounts are small relative to the business
Revenue declines, subscriber losses and margins are internally consistent and in line with cable-industry trends; capitalization of labor/CPE costs is a standard but judgmental area
